title: Eager/Lazy Load Misalignment (Lazy Loading Exceptions)
pattern: Passing active ORM-managed entities containing unresolved lazy-loaded collections or relationships to outer presentation or service layers outside of the active transaction/session boundary.
why_bad: It results in runtime exceptions or silent failures (like LazyInitializationException) when the outer layer tries to access un-fetched associations after the database session has closed.
detection: Accessing lazily-evaluated collection fields of an ORM entity outside the module/block marked with transaction boundaries or lifetime scopes.
counterexample: Mapping the entity to a clean, fully-resolved Data Transfer Object (DTO) inside the transaction boundary before returning it.
fix: Fetch the required associations eagerly in the query, or use a use-case-specific Strategy (Domain Dependency Resolver) to fully resolve fields before transaction commit.
